N-Tech Digital Solutions
Website: https://ntechdigital.solutions
Location: Omaha, Nebraska. Serving the Omaha metro and Lincoln, NE; remote-friendly across the U.S.
Contact: hello@ntechdigital.solutions
Founder & principal: Robert Nattrass

What N-Tech does
N-Tech installs one connected infrastructure system for local service businesses, rather than
selling a website, lead generation, and social media as separate services. The five components are
built so each one feeds the next: a missed call becomes a booked appointment, a form fill becomes a
followed-up lead, a finished job becomes a public review.

The five components
- Website — fast, mobile-first, with a lead form and a Call Now button on every page. The form
  writes directly into the CRM; the Call Now button routes to the AI receptionist.
- AI Receptionist — answers calls the team can't take (nights, weekends, busy periods), attempts to
  book the appointment on the call, and logs every caller's details in the CRM.
- Lead Form Automation — instant CRM entry on submission, plus an automatic SMS/email confirming the
  lead is reachable, after which AI receptionist follow-up takes over.
- Social Media Management — Facebook and Instagram posting, plus automated outreach to anyone who
  engages with a post, funnelling them into the same lead pipeline.
- Google Review Automation — 5-star experiences are routed to post publicly on Google; anything
  below 5 stars is intercepted as private feedback so the business can respond before it goes live.

Pricing
One flat monthly retainer covers all five components. There is no separate build fee. N-Tech is
running a limited case-study pricing phase to get honest results from a first five clients before
standard rates take effect, so no figure is published on the public site — it is given on the call.
Paid ad management and ad spend are a separate add-on, raised after onboarding.

What N-Tech does not claim
No guarantees of leads or revenue. No published case studies yet — the first five case-study clients
are being onboarded, and results will be published when they land.

Blog editorial direction
Long-tail, winnable queries: how-tos, comparisons, checklists, industry-specific problems, and
measurement. Each post maps to one primary intent and links to a relevant page and to /book-call.
